programme.desc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
programme.desc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮

programme.title: 罪慾 - 虛擬遊戲
programme.desc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: 罪慾 - 地獄門
programme.desc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀

programme.title: 聖山村迷局
programme.desc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底

programme.title: Hide Seek (aka The Last Hide Seek)
programme.desc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: 珍妮花離開虐待她的丈夫後搬進了新公寓。當她準備開展新生活時,卻發現睡覺時總被某些東西咬一口,使她變得睡眠不足和疑神疑鬼,更產生了莫名的恐懼。

programme.title: 錯愛迷蹤
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷

programme.title: 天之書
programme.desc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……

programme.title: 鬼太監
programme.desc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦,朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕,桂竟利用父女之情,假借燕燕之手殺朱锦

programme.title: 明月刀雪夜殲仇
programme.desc: 改編自古龍原著小說,講述「天下第一快刀」傅紅雪為報父仇,萬里尋凶;期間墮入七名兇手布下之圈套,處境岌岌可危

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。

programme.title: 千門八將
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述,正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次,他在與“賭魔”的賭局中,被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後,賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇,正將被賭魔以千術擊敗,含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇,邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博

programme.title: 藍與黑續集
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集,唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯,在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞,但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍,叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。

programme.title: 卒仔抽車
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子,遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成,達成了一個賭局,要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力,終戰勝億萬富豪!

programme.title: 老夫子
programme.desc: 與老夫子一起經歷連串的漫畫故事,看他和他傻頭傻腦的好友大番薯如何為抱得美人歸而弄至笑話連篇!

programme.title: 孔雀王朝
programme.desc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王,正值莊內嚴肅之際,其未婚妻竟無理取鬧,沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後,二人繼續追捕歡喜王,但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。

programme.title: 雙星伴月
programme.desc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓,生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星,從此飛黃騰達,但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西

programme.title: 六刺客
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡,魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上,卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客,再與他們結盟,密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中,夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南,兩人漸生情愫,卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時,青青卻得知一個噩耗,最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。

programme.title: 花街時代
programme.desc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…

programme.title: 水滸傳
programme.desc: 此片是張徹導演的史詩式武俠鉅作。宋朝官府被貪官污吏和土豪劣紳控制,於是宋江帶領一百零八位英雄義士齊集梁山。這羣實力非凡的英雄好漢,形成了一股強大的武裝勢力,一場梁山好漢與官府的大戰就此展開。

programme.title: 楊乃武與小白菜
programme.desc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……

programme.title: 陰陽刀
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?

programme.title: 花木蘭
programme.desc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記
programme.desc: 元朝時,武林中人都在爭奪倚天劍、屠龍刀這兩件武林神器;兩件神器只需一併在手,方可找出秘密,雄霸天下。張無忌機緣巧合下練得九陽神功,因此也捲入了這場紛爭百年的武林是非中。

programme.title: 女兒國
programme.desc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經,行至西梁女兒國,國內全是女人,而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」,飲過這泉水便可成孕,但也只能生女。

programme.title: 南斗官三鬥北少爺
programme.desc: 廣東大良富家子斗官學得一身功夫,在鄉間常闖禍;其母希望斗官娶妻立品,乃遣其上京參加香格格招親大會。其實斗官所以答允上京,目的是找名傳京城的三名北少爺-「千術北少爺」車載、泡妞高手「真厲害」和「神偷北少爺」時三手一較高下。四人不打不相識,最後更成為好友,合力對付仇家三眼道人

programme.title: 武則天

programme.title: 東北戀哥

programme.title: 天地寶蓮燈

programme.title: 龍雀衛之噬魂蛛
programme.desc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #10
programme.desc: 從高地到阿爾卑斯山,歐洲令人回味的景致成為了野生動物劇的史詩式背景通常,堅忍的歐洲馬鹿在發情期會變得狂野,狼群發生領土衝突,狐狸踏著狐步- 這並非聽起來般美好

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #1
programme.desc: 東部灰大袋鼠是最善於交際的袋鼠科動物之一,以稱之為暴徒的小社群聚居暴徒就像袋鼠的社交網絡,由2至100隻袋鼠一起餵哺成員可自出自入,視乎食物供應情況而定

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #2
programme.desc: 養育袋鼠寶寶充滿挑戰性:掠食者,極端天氣和非常活潑的小袋鼠意味著袋鼠媽媽每天都要努力讓下一代存活本集跟隨兩位袋鼠媽媽 - 羅倫和蒂莉,且看她們如何努力養育孩子

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #3
programme.desc: 對於雄性袋鼠來說,努力繁衍代表著充滿風險和回報的生活雖然女性生活在既定的家園內,並以和平的社群聚集,但男性的生活則十分危險很多雄性袋鼠在鄉郊徘徊尋找伴侶這讓他們接觸更多雌性,但一直移動代表他們面臨更多來自多變氣候,繁忙道路和可能遭農民射殺的危險

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #6 英普
programme.desc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #7 英普
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一群獨特的動物

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #8 英普
programme.desc: 太陽在這個乾旱的半島上統管一切,尤其是在七月但從單峰駱駝到如幻術師般的科威特蜥蜴,再到可愛的蹄兔,牠們都有特殊的適應能力來抵抗沙漠的高溫

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #5 英普
programme.desc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #6 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面牠們是森林的「大使」

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #7 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #8 英普
programme.desc: 每年旱季,隨著洪水消失,潘塔納爾濕地的草原就成為許多物種的家:巨型食蟻獸,鬃狼和更大的品種 - 南美洲最大的鳥類

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #9 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,生物學家卡露蓮娜莉巴絲和她的當地導遊,亞莉莉泰蓮娜尋找一個巨大的水獺巢穴儘管體型龐大,嘈雜且具有群居性質,這班瀕臨絕種的巨型水獺卻是出了名的害羞而且難以被找到

programme.title: 昆蟲啟示錄 #1

programme.title: 昆蟲啟示錄 #2
programme.desc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠

programme.title: 昆蟲啟示錄 #3

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #10
programme.desc: 從高地到阿爾卑斯山,歐洲令人回味的景致成為了野生動物劇的史詩式背景通常,堅忍的歐洲馬鹿在發情期會變得狂野,狼群發生領土衝突,狐狸踏著狐步- 這並非聽起來般美好

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #1
programme.desc: 東部灰大袋鼠是最善於交際的袋鼠科動物之一,以稱之為暴徒的小社群聚居暴徒就像袋鼠的社交網絡,由2至100隻袋鼠一起餵哺成員可自出自入,視乎食物供應情況而定

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #2
programme.desc: 養育袋鼠寶寶充滿挑戰性:掠食者,極端天氣和非常活潑的小袋鼠意味著袋鼠媽媽每天都要努力讓下一代存活本集跟隨兩位袋鼠媽媽 - 羅倫和蒂莉,且看她們如何努力養育孩子

programme.title: 袋鼠異聞錄 #3
programme.desc: 對於雄性袋鼠來說,努力繁衍代表著充滿風險和回報的生活雖然女性生活在既定的家園內,並以和平的社群聚集,但男性的生活則十分危險很多雄性袋鼠在鄉郊徘徊尋找伴侶這讓他們接觸更多雌性,但一直移動代表他們面臨更多來自多變氣候,繁忙道路和可能遭農民射殺的危險

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #6 英普
programme.desc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #7 英普
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一群獨特的動物

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #8 英普
programme.desc: 太陽在這個乾旱的半島上統管一切,尤其是在七月但從單峰駱駝到如幻術師般的科威特蜥蜴,再到可愛的蹄兔,牠們都有特殊的適應能力來抵抗沙漠的高溫

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #5 英普
programme.desc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #6 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面牠們是森林的「大使」

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #7 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #8 英普
programme.desc: 每年旱季,隨著洪水消失,潘塔納爾濕地的草原就成為許多物種的家:巨型食蟻獸,鬃狼和更大的品種 - 南美洲最大的鳥類

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #9 英普
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,生物學家卡露蓮娜莉巴絲和她的當地導遊,亞莉莉泰蓮娜尋找一個巨大的水獺巢穴儘管體型龐大,嘈雜且具有群居性質,這班瀕臨絕種的巨型水獺卻是出了名的害羞而且難以被找到

Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? programme.title: Into Water & Beyond
programme.desc: Lady Elliot is a small coral cay on the southern part of the Great Barrier Reef The Island is made up of coral It looks pretty spectacular from the air with aqua blue water surrounding the entire island It’s almost like Disneyland for the underwater world

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.title: Summer In The Black Forest
programme.desc: Continuing her journey through the Black Forest, Liu has to catch and forage for her dinner, and has a wine tasting in a cellar where they used to hold witch trials

programme.title: The Boat Show
programme.desc: Luxury sailing, power boats, water sports and a nautical lifestyle This show is for anyone who dreams of owning a vboat, of a life aboard ship, of beautiful people and places, and super yachts

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: This ancient city, once threatened by the teeth of modern development, stands proud as one of China’s defining economical centers, and one of the few to retain their original visage The institutions honed and developed in this ancient city have long been lost, but the city’s remarkable architecture and history remain very much intact The pioneers of the Chinese financial system came from this city, making their marks in every corner of the country Their influence swelled well beyond the thick city walls, leaving behind an impressive legacy of commerce, finance and business Discover China, as we unlock the vault containing the valuable secrets of Ancient Pingyao

programme.title: Amazing Spa Towns Of Europe
programme.desc: Ellen’s final day in the Czech Republic sees her learning a lot about mud She also releases a bird back to the wild, visits an aquapark, and quickly regrets sticking her head down a hole in the ground!

programme.title: It's More Fun in the Philippines
programme.desc: As their tour continues, Liü is enticed into a rooftop dance, and Mel has to face her fear of heights After a sunset river trip, the pair set out on an island-hopping day to the idyllic Selfie Island

programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.desc: This ancient city, once threatened by the teeth of modern development, stands proud as one of China’s defining economical centers, and one of the few to retain their original visage The institutions honed and developed in this ancient city have long been lost, but the city’s remarkable architecture and history remain very much intact The pioneers of the Chinese financial system came from this city, making their marks in every corner of the country Their influence swelled well beyond the thick city walls, leaving behind an impressive legacy of commerce, finance and business Discover China, as we unlock the vault containing the valuable secrets of Ancient Pingyao

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: China is usually seen through the lens of economics, politics and a regimented population But in Stepping Out we meet people who have left home and set out on the road to discover their China and themselves Su Min, who feels she has done her duty as daughter, wife, mother and grandmother and in her 50’s left her abusive husband; Kiwi, a two-year-old whose parents lost their jobs in the pandemic and not owning a house, travel China in their RV as a family; and Alex a graphic designer exploring his country with his retired mother Through their travels and their lives, we see a different life in China – a freedom to travel, explore, visit amazing places but taking all the benefits of technology to promote themselves and make a living The film was made in July 2022 by students from CUC Nanjing and is directed by their tutor

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: China is usually seen through the lens of economics, politics and a regimented population But in Stepping Out we meet people who have left home and set out on the road to discover their China and themselves Su Min, who feels she has done her duty as daughter, wife, mother and grandmother and in her 50’s left her abusive husband; Kiwi, a two-year-old whose parents lost their jobs in the pandemic and not owning a house, travel China in their RV as a family; and Alex a graphic designer exploring his country with his retired mother Through their travels and their lives, we see a different life in China – a freedom to travel, explore, visit amazing places but taking all the benefits of technology to promote themselves and make a living The film was made in July 2022 by students from CUC Nanjing and is directed by their tutor

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe

programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:愛是有『原』 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 做「女神」要有「仙氣」，數十年前追求女生則少不了「抄牌」和Call機！四位主持扮鬼扮馬，探究與戀愛相關的昔日俗語和現時潮語。「幣少」愛用「散紙」，無知店員竟以為其珍藏「一文不值」，且由鄭Sir趣談斗零、一蚊雞等貨幣的掌故歷史。「巴閉」本土味濃，詞語竟然來自印度！兩大食神以「揚州炒飯」、「京都骨」比拼廚藝，美食卻可能違反商品說明條例？眾人在順德大吃「正斗」陳村粉，廖Sir順道講解「陳村種」的由來。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 被列為「世界遺產」的開平碉樓，設計特別以作防禦土匪來襲。三名「老千」企圖侵吞碉樓，蕭博士如何藉着歷史知識揭破騙局？地產界術語別具創意，「吊臘鴨」、「BBQ」意即凶宅，「黑廁」、「油雞」又意何所指？翻看昔日售樓書，不設電梯竟是賣點！「火水哥」在求職中心得「女神」朱智賢提供就業輔導，期間帶出「吞泡」、「劈炮」等俗語的出處。看電影需要「解畫」、「戲橋」，多買座位只為「曬行頭」，鄭Sir細數當年睇戲文化。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐挑戰自己，與譚玉瑛、黃智賢一同答題測智慧！一個藝人名字，輕易令眾人猜到曼谷「冬蔭功湯」的特別煮法。東京的八層雪糕有何最潮食法？聖地牙哥的軍車載客人享用甚麼？擔當主持的農夫能否享用阿拉斯加皇帝蟹？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 走入曼谷首間以狐狸作主題的餐廳前，要做些甚麼？高海寧發揮智慧之餘，亦展現幽默感。競猜西雅圖一堵香口膠牆的所在地，使方力申散發出個人魅力。首爾有餐廳只有一張餐桌，兩人輕易猜出餐廳主題，與美食走近一步！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英PG
programme.desc: 一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 當玫露熊來到閃亮CHU的家裡玩，便發現閃亮CHU一早就吃豬排飯，房間也沒有打掃，令玫露熊與安娜大為詫異。在安娜的建議下，奇蹟閃耀組來到星夢電子蛋中心，學習星夢電子蛋的用法，讓自己能更好地照料閃亮CHU。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢拿出「總統之書」，讓任何人都能夠頒布政策，出木杉見狀提議辦一場正式的總統大選。大雄難耐被媽媽長時間訓話，多啦A夢於是借他「瘋狂時間器」，讓他可以局部性改變時間流逝的速度。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 踏入冬假，在真子提議下，大家展開了一場歸鄉之旅。經過長途跋涉，大家來到真子祖母的祖屋，其傳統氣息讓九禮亞等人大開眼界。其後，真子與詩音再會小學時代的好友，大家懷緬往昔之餘，也說起近來的樂事。

programme.title: 一路繁花粵
programme.desc: 子羚、蓓蔚行逛進賢路，《繁花》裡的248號縱找不着，卻有口福可吃到滋味麵食。到訪改建自江南傳統民居的民宿，感受三百年歷史氣息。再於朱家角「掃街」，女主持們暫放下儀態在路旁吃糉。置身劇中「寶總」和「玲子」吃泡飯的地方，細嚐相同的味道。「排骨年糕」是上海人的童年回憶，必試百年老店出品。享用由楊貫一徒弟煮理的二頭吉品鮑，再嚐用牛肉製作的叉燒，矜貴又美味。靖峰獲紅幫裁縫傳人度身定製西裝，限定變身「冼總」。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 「學院派」大師兄Alan如願向師弟保哥下戰書，二人狹路相逢，誓要煮出感動媽媽的味道！梁芷珮擔任嘉賓評判，一起見證這場同門爭霸。Alan的蹄香夾心咕嚕肉包含甜酸苦辣，體現「媽媽的辛勤」。花膠粥加入黃油雞湯殊不簡單；另有「秘密武器」冰碟作擺盤，保哥怎樣接招？越式蒸腸粉、海鮮酸辣湯滿載着保哥與母親的相處點滴，希望藉着兩道家鄉菜觸動大家。保哥自製小工具在鍋上蒸腸粉，拉粉皮時卻頻頻失手，唯有兵行險着……

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 生力軍嘉星越級挑戰Ricky，兩位西廚以「中菜西做」的方式作比拼。Ricky預告會炮製酥皮楊枝甘露，何以不被幟哥看好？為了解開對陳皮鴨腿湯飯的心結，Ricky無懼扣分，拿出「秘密武器」……一道螢光魷魚涼拌青瓜，嘉星加入混合中西元素的「陳醋珠珠」。另再拌勻帶子、蛋白、牛油，蒸出香滑豆腐的口感。嘉賓張曦雯對各款創新料理甚感滿意，幟哥卻挑剔菜式名稱。新穎的食材配搭，還是煮得貼題，能夠贏得評判們的歡心？

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 齋是農曆新年的常見菜式，本集Gigi姐會示範烹煮現代版本，例如以前的齋是有髮菜的，但現在因為保護環境而不會再用。而傳統的齋總給人油膩的感覺，Gigi姐教大家挑選比較健康又耐熱的油，最適合用來做這道齋。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 阿古(古嘉俊)在復活節示範的一款特色朱古力，曾令譚嘉儀眼界大開。事隔四個月，嘉儀再次「捲土重來」，向他請教更多甜品新創意。阿古當然不會讓她失望而回，選用了兩款破格食材─ 佛手柑與西班牙鼠尾草籽，炮製一款口味創新的「佛手柑士多啤梨白朱古力慕絲蛋糕」。為白朱古力外層加入鼠尾草籽，靈感乃來自奇異果爽脆質感。佛手柑味道苦澀而且帶有微酸，大膽選材竟是為健康著想？就由阿古解讀當中創意構思。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴和伊奈在廢校元宇宙找到比娜，但後者旋即消失。太晴在自己的元宇宙火車站發現比娜，抓住對方的時候更窺見其記憶。比娜獲救後，卻表示決定不再回去，其後UNKNOWN突然出現，太晴被迫應戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 十二歲少女伴隨古典音樂翩然起舞，帶來優雅的芭蕾舞表演。為繼續深造舞技，她更計劃前赴英國升學，勇敢追夢。另一位男生則為「My Little Show」舞台送上彈琴演出，他彈奏的悅耳琴聲，令主持姐姐隨着音樂放鬆心情。每當聽到電視劇主題曲的音樂，便會喚起觀眾對劇集的回憶。這回，主持姐姐會跟結他導師合唱處境劇《愛．回家》和《男親女愛》的主題曲。此外，導師還會介紹「音孔蓋」，這個輔助器材有助降低結他的音量。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子放學回家，被爺爺發現有毛蟲在書包上面。小丸子因此突發奇想，想出了一個遊戲。山根希望被人以匿稱稱呼，於是在想改一個怎樣的匿稱。小丸子見狀積極配合，但永澤對此事十分反感。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 去年有多間戲院相繼結業，但同時亦出現有投資者承接結業戲院，以擴充院線的情況。AI除了成為企業請人時，要求應徵者擁有的技能，亦是協助企業篩選求職者的工具。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 受中東局勢影響，過去數月國際油價波動，連帶推高石油副產品的成本。今集會走訪「搵食車」司機、私家車車主及飲食業界，了解油費上漲，成本如何沿供應鏈蔓延至市民生計？千里之外的戰爭，同時敲響能源警號，香港作為高度依賴進口能源的城市，這場風波，為本港長遠能源發展政策又帶來甚麼啟示？

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾報料外出吃火鍋竟發現蟑螂蹤影，店家衛生似乎欠佳。在內地常引起爭議，甚至被稱「僵屍舞」的「佳木斯操」，近年流入本港，更於荃灣、紅磡、將軍澳區內的休憩公園落地生根。附近街坊卻投訴做操人士造成聲音滋擾、有玩陀螺青年反被指聲浪大，阻礙做操者跳舞播歌；節目組嘗試拆解「佳操」這個文化現象。另外，眾演員為新劇《非份之罪》宣傳、連詩雅獲丈夫陳家樂驚喜慶生、新一季《江湖見》舉行記招、陳豪參演廣告，分別送上花絮。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「中一二三助力賽」下半場，以《中年好聲音4》男子組主題曲<男人的浪漫為賽事預熱。緊接着，眾位師兄、師姐將為同樣未亮相的十三強參賽者助力合唱。所有助力舞台完成後，最低分的選手隨即展開加時PK賽，重新演繹各人於一百強階段的參賽歌曲，評審們會根據表現淘汰一人。本集除了有孫耀威繼續駐任「嘉賓評審」，並負責選出這輪比拼的MVP外，也有前輩主持鄧梓峰、資深DJ李志剛加入「知音人」行列。

programme.title: 歐洲坊鐘錶呈獻：一周星星粵
programme.desc: 黎芷珊終於約到「校長」譚詠麟單獨受訪，校長同時公佈將舉行終極篇巡迴演唱！從溫拿樂隊年代講起，校長稱收入要五人均分實不多，但當年也足以置業？而他亦有投資不同生意，包括石油氣站、廣告、物流車隊！八十年代獨立發展，校長奪獎無數，卻自言宣佈停止領獎後的歌路才廣闊？千禧年代和李克勤合體開騷，只因記者的提問促成？校長一直提攜後輩，寄語大家遵守其「三心兩意」格言，此話何解？他還重提歌唱生涯的一個遺憾，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 行仔相約「星級飯腳」郭偉亮及女團XiX的成員「開餐」，到郭偉亮的愛店品嚐越式法包、河內火車頭湯河粉等越南美食，味道正宗。灣仔的法式甜品店甜點款式繁多，黑檸檬撻與布列塔尼酥餅皆是必吃之選。陳國強師傅帶暉哥到馬來西亞的馬六甲覓食，造訪老字號沙嗲店，細嚐豬肉串燒及豬粉腸等內臟串燒，搭配海南風味秘製沙嗲醬，滋味倍增。深水埗地膽昌哥帶伍倩彤走訪區內多間老店，推介腸粉、桑寄生蓮子蛋茶等美食，滿載回憶的味道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#10粵PG
programme.desc: 寶群到寺廟求問女兒下落，偶遇屠敏，卻沒有認出她。卓廷光派人砍掉阮春海的手，令其作品快速升值。以凡到家晴家看影片，子峰帶著禮物來找家晴，卻在門外聽見二人嬉鬧之聲。曉山陪子峰消遣解愁，曉山對他暗生情愫。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 齋是農曆新年的常見菜式，本集Gigi姐會示範烹煮現代版本，例如以前的齋是有髮菜的，但現在因為保護環境而不會再用。而傳統的齋總給人油膩的感覺，Gigi姐教大家挑選比較健康又耐熱的油，最適合用來做這道齋。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 阿古(古嘉俊)在復活節示範的一款特色朱古力，曾令譚嘉儀眼界大開。事隔四個月，嘉儀再次「捲土重來」，向他請教更多甜品新創意。阿古當然不會讓她失望而回，選用了兩款破格食材─ 佛手柑與西班牙鼠尾草籽，炮製一款口味創新的「佛手柑士多啤梨白朱古力慕絲蛋糕」。為白朱古力外層加入鼠尾草籽，靈感乃來自奇異果爽脆質感。佛手柑味道苦澀而且帶有微酸，大膽選材竟是為健康著想？就由阿古解讀當中創意構思。

programme.title: 一路繁花粵
programme.desc: 子羚、蓓蔚行逛進賢路，《繁花》裡的248號縱找不着，卻有口福可吃到滋味麵食。到訪改建自江南傳統民居的民宿，感受三百年歷史氣息。再於朱家角「掃街」，女主持們暫放下儀態在路旁吃糉。置身劇中「寶總」和「玲子」吃泡飯的地方，細嚐相同的味道。「排骨年糕」是上海人的童年回憶，必試百年老店出品。享用由楊貫一徒弟煮理的二頭吉品鮑，再嚐用牛肉製作的叉燒，矜貴又美味。靖峰獲紅幫裁縫傳人度身定製西裝，限定變身「冼總」。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 「學院派」大師兄Alan如願向師弟保哥下戰書，二人狹路相逢，誓要煮出感動媽媽的味道！梁芷珮擔任嘉賓評判，一起見證這場同門爭霸。Alan的蹄香夾心咕嚕肉包含甜酸苦辣，體現「媽媽的辛勤」。花膠粥加入黃油雞湯殊不簡單；另有「秘密武器」冰碟作擺盤，保哥怎樣接招？越式蒸腸粉、海鮮酸辣湯滿載着保哥與母親的相處點滴，希望藉着兩道家鄉菜觸動大家。保哥自製小工具在鍋上蒸腸粉，拉粉皮時卻頻頻失手，唯有兵行險着……

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 生力軍嘉星越級挑戰Ricky，兩位西廚以「中菜西做」的方式作比拼。Ricky預告會炮製酥皮楊枝甘露，何以不被幟哥看好？為了解開對陳皮鴨腿湯飯的心結，Ricky無懼扣分，拿出「秘密武器」……一道螢光魷魚涼拌青瓜，嘉星加入混合中西元素的「陳醋珠珠」。另再拌勻帶子、蛋白、牛油，蒸出香滑豆腐的口感。嘉賓張曦雯對各款創新料理甚感滿意，幟哥卻挑剔菜式名稱。新穎的食材配搭，還是煮得貼題，能夠贏得評判們的歡心？

programme.desc: 根家成為溢及義的玩樂場所，花求根收留她。三人被花打消了看電影的興致，花突然由房中走出來打掃客廳，原來花自幼便已患上夢遊症。三人乘機作弄花至皮膚敏感，唯有請假休息，但義等人認為又可作重施故技。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 姚惜覺得張遮配不上自己，想要退親，尤月獻計，只要散播張遮命中剋妻的謠言，姚家即可退親，姜雪寧聽後教訓了尤月一頓。姜雪寧讓尤芳吟找許文益買下生絲，靜候時機。周寅之在侯府暗查時，竟發現了平南王的徽記殘片…

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 塵蟎、寵物等是常見的吸入性致敏原，有機會引起鼻敏感、哮喘等過敏反應。而脫敏治療可逐步改變免疫系統反應，從而減輕症狀。與一般抗敏藥物不同，脫敏治療屬「治本」療法，專科醫生詳述相關資訊。何嘉莉近期再度活躍幕前，她於早前播放的劇集《重案解密》飾演反派，對角色大有發揮感開心。她亦將首次參演舞台劇，直言享受這個新嘗試。嘉莉又分享如何兼顧家庭與事業，以及育兒心得。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「菠蘿『生』燜牛肉」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 全港估計有150萬人患上不同程度的濕疹，有甚麼先天成因？不少患者因怕副作用而避用類固醇藥育，採用濕裹治療就有助增加類固醇的吸收。另外，中醫師帶來自製止痕噴霧、外用貼與浴球的做法。《中年好聲音》參賽者梁德欣曾經常頭痛與長期低燒而求診，輾轉要看不同專科，後來證實患上紅斑狼瘡症。雖說蝴蝶斑是病症最明顯的皮膚表徵，內科醫生提到判症並非如此單一；醫生指出已有藥物可控制病情，鼓勵患者與病症共存，與「狼」共舞！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#11粵PG
programme.desc: 蓉蓉送受傷的高哲上船療傷，蓉蓉奇怪高哲為何有槍，眾俠盜只表示蓉蓉要相信高哲。大海剖析江揚師傅為何做賊。江揚得知高哲被槍擊，找蓉蓉套口風。譚彬向江翹表白被拒，明翔目擊經過，更被譚彬發現她對自己有意。高哲向蓉蓉表示不想連累她，蓉蓉以為高哲嫌她無用，兩人冷戰。美莉向蓉蓉講出自己不孕的秘密。美莉升職後巧遇君豪，更應邀用膳，被跟蹤君豪的大海發現。江揚找高哲，直指其口供有疑點，期間殺手出現，被兩人合力擊退。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵

programme.desc: 早前「東張」報道西貢黃石營地被長期霸佔一事後，當局隨即派員清理，惟近日又有觀眾報料指大型帳篷「霸住」情況在附近營地重現？「佳木斯操」被指攻入本港，造成噪音等滋擾！攝製隊繼續走訪多區公園，了解佳操文化，卻遇到不禮拜對待，甚至遭潑水、搶手機；另有陀螺青年曾因不同問題與佳操隊發生爭執？新處境喜劇《愛．回家之三代同糖》舉行造型活動，眾演員搶先披露角色。控醣人士管理飲食的同時，也要均衡地補充營養，有何建議？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2839粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威佩服Coupon女皇，誓要揭開其神秘身分，但差點受騙，幸得天娥及時阻止。力蓮奇怪天娥何以識破騙局，天娥只好託辭圓謊。另一方面，天娥以Coupon女皇身分與金主會面，卻生變故。其後，敢威在公開場合頻頻「失威」，原來天娥受人威脅，被迫搞破壞。天娥本想向敢威坦白身分，但始終不敢，直至從敢佳口中得知一事，並查明屬實，遂有恃無恐，設法為敢威「報仇」，並坦白真相，詎料……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#1粵PG
programme.desc: 婦產科醫生康力和外籍妻子白美雅恩愛非常，大女兒康嘉嵐和小女兒康嘉儀是父母的掌上明珠，然而這家人的幸福背後，藏着三位女士無香港身份證的秘密。為保護家庭，康力訂立嚴厲家規要兩姊妹遵守，可是愛自由的嘉嵐偷偷帶嘉儀去酒吧玩，竟遇上警察來查毒品。嘉嵐、嘉儀雖成功逃走，但康力決定軟禁嘉嵐在房。嘉嵐騙嘉儀放自己出房，更偷走康力的現金離家出走。嘉儀因嘉嵐失聯幾天擔心不已，直至看到新聞報道一則無面女屍發現案……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 塵蟎、寵物等是常見的吸入性致敏原，有機會引起鼻敏感、哮喘等過敏反應。而脫敏治療可逐步改變免疫系統反應，從而減輕症狀。與一般抗敏藥物不同，脫敏治療屬「治本」療法，專科醫生詳述相關資訊。何嘉莉近期再度活躍幕前，她於早前播放的劇集《重案解密》飾演反派，對角色大有發揮感開心。她亦將首次參演舞台劇，直言享受這個新嘗試。嘉莉又分享如何兼顧家庭與事業，以及育兒心得。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「菠蘿『生』燜牛肉」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 全港估計有150萬人患上不同程度的濕疹，有甚麼先天成因？不少患者因怕副作用而避用類固醇藥育，採用濕裹治療就有助增加類固醇的吸收。另外，中醫師帶來自製止痕噴霧、外用貼與浴球的做法。《中年好聲音》參賽者梁德欣曾經常頭痛與長期低燒而求診，輾轉要看不同專科，後來證實患上紅斑狼瘡症。雖說蝴蝶斑是病症最明顯的皮膚表徵，內科醫生提到判症並非如此單一；醫生指出已有藥物可控制病情，鼓勵患者與病症共存，與「狼」共舞！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#11粵PG
programme.desc: 蓉蓉送受傷的高哲上船療傷，蓉蓉奇怪高哲為何有槍，眾俠盜只表示蓉蓉要相信高哲。大海剖析江揚師傅為何做賊。江揚得知高哲被槍擊，找蓉蓉套口風。譚彬向江翹表白被拒，明翔目擊經過，更被譚彬發現她對自己有意。高哲向蓉蓉表示不想連累她，蓉蓉以為高哲嫌她無用，兩人冷戰。美莉向蓉蓉講出自己不孕的秘密。美莉升職後巧遇君豪，更應邀用膳，被跟蹤君豪的大海發現。江揚找高哲，直指其口供有疑點，期間殺手出現，被兩人合力擊退。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#129粵

programme.desc: Minnie出任法律部主管，家聰設法「搞對抗」。Minnie回家仍要為家聰的文件「執手尾」，家聰卻不斷出招騷擾，令她苦不堪言。莫明詩替家聰不值，並察覺家聰的心思全在Minnie身上，認為是她故意引起注意，遂暗中對付她，意外取得載有重要文件的usb，令她得罪貴客。家聰本想藉usb立功，但他偷聽敢威責怪Minnie，意外聽到意想不到的秘密。家聰決意歸還usb，遂找藉口走進Minnie住所，伺機歸還……

programme.desc: 康力叫嘉儀不要為新聞中的無臉女屍胡亂猜測，但嘉儀還是擔心不已，故瞞着父母去找嘉嵐的秘密男友王思勤，更找上在圖書館認識的記者朋友韋家俊壯膽，從酒保中得知思勤是個壞男人！嘉儀收到嘉嵐的報平安訊息，然而，康力怕嘉嵐在外惹事而影響家庭，決定帶嘉儀母女離開香港，回到美雅的原居地重過新生。嘉儀成功猜中嘉嵐社交媒體帳戶的密碼，偷遛到思勤就讀的大學去找他。思勤答應帶嘉儀去見嘉嵐，怎料……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵

獵鷹#10粵
programme.desc: 大偉到別區掃蕩白粉檔，郭警司不滿，大偉藉機與他衝突然請辭，以便替劉Sir辦事；戚幹不明所以，責罵大偉，大偉有口難言。國基見大偉無所事事，自動借予數千元，戚幹責罵大偉，江霞亦不滿大偉不夠坦白。大偉任職保險公司但一事無成，故意在國基面前表現不得志，與國基出外鬼混，戚幹斥責大偉自甘墮落，大偉藉口對家庭不滿，與國基商量遷居別處，國基慫恿大偉到夜總會當領班，以支付昂貴租金，江霞不欲大偉搬往別處，但無法阻止。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不少癌症患者選用中醫加上西醫的聯合治療，中醫學主張「扶正培本」，以其治癌的成效數字怎樣？中藥如何減低治癌西藥產生的副作用？前來的中醫師亦提到香港中醫醫院、跨境醫健通等政策為病人帶來的實際幫助。殿堂級歌手葉振棠唱過無數金曲，他將再開騷，這次為何邀龍婷出任嘉賓？龍婷參加《中年好聲音》前已和棠哥合作過，當時感覺如何？二人預告演唱會將發放驚喜，還分享養聲秘技。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「麻香爆炒雞軟骨」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 患者多為婦女的乳癌、子宮內膜癌等頑疾，永城以為事不關己，事實卻非如此！藝員林淑敏是乳癌康復者，她透露起初是自行觸摸時察覺異常。醫生教大家自檢步驟，另介紹新式3D檢查技術；基因測試可及早識別患癌風險，醫生建議哪些人士接受偵測？傳聞豆漿、木瓜不適合乳癌患者，營養師指出相關謬誤。子宮內膜癌的病徵相對明顯，及早發現可透過微創手術治療，醫生細說詳情。永城也會了解男士接種HPV疫苗，如何有助減低伴侶染病風險。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 譚彬在遊戲機中心玩射擊遊戲，江翹中途加入，兩人和好。有人目擊明翔、譚彬脅持經琛，警方向君豪求證，君豪否認。江揚查到高哲和趙家的恩怨，警方對俠盜集團展開人盯人策略；君豪交贖金當日，俠盜集團仍順利擺脫跟蹤。君豪在城門河邊放下公事包，然後跳河，警方發現袋內並無贖款。江揚決定放眾人一馬。原來今次是經琛和高哲為對付君豪合演的一場戲，高哲亦趁機考驗蓉蓉。中醫指美莉的不孕無藥可治，美莉終向江揚坦白。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#130粵
programme.desc: 眾人趕回家，原來喜重煮十年沒製作的鹹蛋肉餅煲仔飯。慶提議中秋節時由喜包辦美食給家人享用，其實喜只懂煮這種煲仔飯。義帶妙喜學廚，可是喜的廚藝沒有因而大進。中秋節終於來到，朋暗地計劃出手救母。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕臨躲在房間喝得爛醉，雪寧得知他並無懷疑自己欺瞞他，只是擔心她該如何自處，很是感動。薛家的絲船沉了，這些年薛家以漕運結黨營私，故必須把事情壓下來。張遮要向家裡退婚，姚惜來質問雪寧和張遮究竟是什麼關係。

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: 小廚神到本地農場一試餵豬及替豬沖涼的滋味，還用味覺感受熟成牛與普通牛扒的分別。每人要煎一塊半熟牛扒，誰人取得十分滿分？今集分組比賽，以派對食物為主題，Nicole的一組把食物幻變成多種海洋生物，但是組員一直吵吵鬧鬧，他們的食物能為評判味蕾帶來歡樂嗎？Cindy一組以夏日為題，美食花款多，卻犯下衛生上的大錯！星級評判張振朗及蝦頭與專業評判，根據組別表現及個人表現頒發團體星章及2顆個人星章，結果如何？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 幽靈醫生(完)
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: The Glass House
programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

programme.desc: Hondo is told to help make peace with Indian Chief Vittoro, whose daughter--Hondo's wife--had been killed by the Cavalry. Once the peace pipe is smoked, Hondo must deal with a renegade Native American who threatens the peace by randomly attacking settlers.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Expedition Killer Whale S01 - EP1

programme.title: Earth S01 - Snowball
programme.desc: Earth's terrifying journey into the deep freeze starts with fire, not ice. 800 million years ago, long before the age of the dinosaurs, before there was even animal life, the giant supercontinent Rodinia breaks up. Earth's vast powerful tectonic forces rip the land apart, kicking off a series of events that results in huge amounts of carbon dioxide being sucked from the atmosphere and sending global temperatures plummeting.

Below the sea ice, conditions have been stable for millennia.

programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch builds his effigy in ice, his digging threatens the Lambert Glacier in Antarctica.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Good, the Bad and the Prickly
programme.desc: Prickly Pear arrives in the supermarket and wants Evil Pea's freezer for his new home.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books in the supermarket to build a huge tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building - only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!
